<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$home = get_page_by_path('home', OBJECT, 'page');
if (!$home) {
    $home_id = wp_insert_post(array(
        'post_type' => 'page',
        'post_status' => 'publish',
        'post_title' => 'Home',
        'post_name' => 'home',
        'post_content' => '',
    ));
} else {
    $home_id = $home->ID;
}

update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
update_option('page_on_front', (int) $home_id);
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');

if (function_exists('threekg_read_bundled_projects') && function_exists('threekg_run_project_import')) {
    $source = threekg_read_bundled_projects();
    if (!is_wp_error($source) && !empty($source['projects'])) {
        threekg_run_project_import($source['projects'], 'publish', false);
    }
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
